# Psalm 71 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-you YHWH I-have-taken-refuge; let-me not be-put-to-shame to-forever.

**2** In-your-righteousness deliver-me and-rescue-me; incline your-ear to-me and-save-me.

**3** Be to-me a-rock of-habitation to-come continually; you-have-commanded to-save-me, for my-rock and-my-fortress you-are.

**4** My-God rescue-me from-hand-of the-wicked, from-palm-of the-unjust and-the-ruthless.

**5** For you-are my-hope Lord YHWH, my-trust from-my-youth.

**6** Upon-you I-have-leaned from-birth; from-womb-of my-mother you-are my-severer; in-you my-praise continually.

**7** As-a-wonder I-have-been to-many, and-you my-refuge strong.

**8** Let-be-filled my-mouth your-praise, all the-day your-glory.

**9** Do-not cast-me-away in-time-of old-age; as-fails my-strength do-not forsake-me.

**10** For have-said my-enemies to-me, and-watchers-of my-soul have-consulted together,

**11** Saying, 'God has-forsaken-him; pursue and-seize-him, for there-is-no deliverer.'

**12** O-God do-not be-far from-me; my-God to-my-help hasten.

**13** Let-be-ashamed let-be-consumed adversaries-of my-soul; let-be-covered-with reproach and-dishonor seekers-of my-harm.

**14** And-I continually will-hope, and-I-will-add upon all your-praise.

**15** My-mouth will-recount your-righteousness, all the-day your-salvation, for not I-know numbers.

**16** I-will-come in-mighty-deeds-of Lord YHWH; I-will-make-mention-of your-righteousness, yours alone.

**17** O-God you-have-taught-me from-my-youth, and-until now I-declare your-wondrous-deeds.

**18** And-also until old-age and-gray-hairs, O-God do-not forsake-me, until I-declare your-arm to-a-generation, to-all who-are-to-come your-might.

**19** And-your-righteousness O-God unto the-height, you-who have-done great-things; O-God who is-like-you?

**20** You-who have-shown-me troubles many and-distresses, you-will-return you-will-revive-me, and-from-depths-of the-earth you-will-return you-will-bring-me-up.

**21** You-will-increase my-greatness, and-you-will-turn you-will-comfort-me.

**22** Also I will-thank-you with-instrument-of harp your-faithfulness my-God; I-will-sing-praises to-you with-the-lyre O-Holy-One-of Israel.

**23** My-lips will-shout-for-joy when I-sing-praises to-you, and-my-soul which you-have-redeemed.

**24** Also my-tongue all the-day will-murmur your-righteousness, for they-are-ashamed for they-are-disgraced seekers-of my-harm.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **71:6**: Hebrew gozi ('my-severer') is obscure; may mean 'one who cut the cord' — preserving literal sense of separation at birth.

- **71:15**: 'Not I-know numbers' — the psalmist cannot count God's righteous acts; the innumerability is emphatic.

- **71:20**: Double use of tashuv ('you-will-return') intensifies the promise of restoration from Sheol-like depths.

— EMET
